data.name: Carlota
data.gender_notes: Carlota is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'Carlus', meaning 'man', and 'ota', meaning 'duty' or 'strength'. In Christian traditions, Carlota represents a woman of strong character and duty towards her faith and community. The name Carlota carries the meaning “Man's duty” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Carlota usually hope their child will grow to embody man's duty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of dedication and commitment to one's beliefs and values.
data.etymology: Carlota belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Man's duty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Carlota total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: קרלוטה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: קרלוטה הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בשם הגרמני קרל, שפירושו 'אדם חופשי'. השם קארל היה פופולרי מאוד בקרב המלכים והאצילים באירופה, והוא קשור קשר הדוק לשושלת הקרולינגית. בהקשר הנוצרי, השם קרלוטה מייצג את החירות והשחרור לנצח באמצעות ישו המשיח. השם גם קשור לנושא השחרור מעבדות החטא והמוות.

in_greek.name: Καρλότα
in_greek.meaning: Ελευθερία και απελευθέρωση από τον Θεό
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Καρλότα προέρχεται από το γερμανικό όνομα Καρλ, που σημαίνει 'ελεύθερος άνθρωπος'. Το όνομα Καρλ ήταν πολύ δημοφιλές ανάμεσα στους βασιλιάδες και τους ευγενείς στην Ευρώπη και συνδέεται στενά με τη δυναστεία των Καρολιγγίων. Στο χριστιανικό πλαίσιο, το όνομα Καρλότα αντιπροσωπεύει την ελευθερία και την απελευθέρωση από τον Θεό μέσω του Ιησού Χριστού. Το όνομα επίσης συνδέεται με το θέμα της απελευθέρωσης από την σκλαβιά του αμαρτήματος και του θανάτου.

in_latin.name: Carlotta
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Carlotta originem habet in nomine germanico Carlu, quod significat 'homo liber'. Nomen Carlu multum populare fuit inter reges et nobiles in Europa, et coniungitur cum dynastia Carolingia. In contextu christiano, nomen Carlotta repraesentat libertatem et aeternam liberationem per Iesum Christum. Nomen etiam coniungitur cum themate liberationis a servitute peccati et mortis.

in_english.name: Carlota
in_english.long_meaning: The name Carlota originates from the Germanic name Carl, meaning 'free man'. It was popularized by the Carolingian dynasty and became a symbol of freedom and nobility. In Christian tradition, Carlota represents spiritual freedom and liberation through Jesus Christ. The name is associated with strength, independence, and courage. It has been used across various cultures, including Spanish, Portuguese, and English-speaking countries.

data.cultural_impact: In various Spanish-speaking cultures, the name Carlota carries connotations of regality and grace. This is due, in part, to the fact that several prominent queens and noblewomen in history have borne this name. For instance, Carlota Josepha of Austria (1785–1849) was the wife of King Ferdinand VII of Spain, while Carlota Felix of Salm-Salm (1800–1824) was the last queen regnant of Etruria before it was annexed by the French. Today, the name can evoke images of feminine power, latin elegance, and historical significance.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Carlota is imbued with a deeper spiritual meaning. The Latin root 'Carlus' signifies the man 'Christ', and the suffix 'ota' emphasizes the importance of steadfastness in Christian life. Thus, Carlota signifies a woman of unwavering faith and strong character, who embodies the spiritual duty to serve and uphold the teachings of Christ. This resonates with the Biblical story of the Samaritan Woman at the Well, who recognized Jesus as the long-awaited Messiah and devotedly spread the good news to her community. Consequently, the name Carlota embodies the spiritual calling of Christ's disciples to be strong and steadfast in faith, as well as to share the teachings of Jesus with others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Carlota, derived from Charles in Greek meaning "man, warrior," embodies the spirit of strength, courage, and determination for women in their faith journey. It's a reminder to embrace one's inner warrior and face life's challenges with unwavering faith and resilience.
